values.note: County fee sheet (approved March 2025, the latest posted): electric $31, full hookup $38, waterfront $45, electric-only tent site $30 per day; extra sleeping tent $12 per reservation; $20 'lock-in fee' to book a specific site on Campspot; bathhouse tokens $1 each. Campspot quoted $42.16 electric, $49.40 full hookup, $56.64 waterfront and $41.12 tent for a closed date (2026-10-27), including Campspot's own booking fee, so 2026 rates may be higher than the 2025 sheet. No resident/non-resident difference posted. A Michigan Recreation Passport is required.

values.note: Bathhouse 6 a.m.-10 p.m., showers by $1 token from the caretaker; water spigots at each end of the park; dumpster by the shower house; firewood and limited camping supplies from the caretaker. No internet.

values.note: Reserve on Campspot (the county page's 'CLICK BELOW TO MAKE RESERVATION' link). Paid in full at booking; 50% refund if cancelled more than 14 days out, none within 14 days. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. A site may not be left unattended more than 16 hours.

Minimum 1-night stay except holiday weekends will require minimum 2-night stay.', 'Reservations are to be paid in full at time of booking...', 'Check-in 3:00 pm; Check-out 11:00 am'), read 2026-10-25

note: Kalkaska County park on small Log Lake east of Kalkaska: sandy swim beach (no lifeguard), pavilions, a disc golf course next door, the North Country Trail a mile north and the Shore-to-Shore horse trail two miles away. Caretakers on site. The county says it opens the last weekend in April. --Claude
